inputs: optional stored excerpts cited by source_document_id and text_hash
outputs: case table: family, checker, expected, actual, pass, severity if missed
proposed unit tests for the checker's own suite
budget: deterministic, no paid calls; pure functions on in-memory cases plus the existing test suites
triggering_workflows: PR changing Knox rules, Rosetta layout, the source check, the limit guard or eval-verdict name rules
a new misleading fee shape seen on prod
failure_behavior: A shape with no pure checker is listed as untested; a case without a certain expected answer is marked unclear and left out of the score.
approval_requirements: None to run. Keeping a case means a normal code PR that waits for CI; no eval_cases rows are written.
abstain_when: no pure checker exists for the shape
the expected verdict is not certain from the text alone
an excerpt cannot be cited to a stored document and a real-world rate is asked for
